scope: small stateless provider pilot of actual RoomStore native context; not a longitudinal personality validation

limits.nextCallTotalTokenUpperBound: not-certified; input byte cap and 50k reserve are conservative guards, not provider tokenizer proof

versions.hashObservation: Entry-module hashes measured at report close, not a loaded dependency build attestation; actual submitted context is preserved with per-trial hashes in prompts.json.

limitations: Tiny heterogeneous case sample; no causal efficacy or stable personality conclusion.
No tools or autonomous memory decisions; material is seeded by the evaluator.
Tests actual bounded native context, not provider/temperature invariance.
Behavioral style and task obedience require reading the preserved answers.
Model/provider identities are route observations, not provider build hashes.
Baseline answered unknown honestly in two recall-limited cases; it did not fabricate a date. Baseline new-task answer was substantively correct but failed strict JSON parsing because of fences.
Zero sample variance here is over three heterogeneous binary case results, not evidence of low model variance. No within-condition replication was done.
